children: The consumer discretionary sector saw a mixed earnings performance this week, with 13 companies reporting quarterly results.
Seven companies beat EPS estimates, five missed, and one came in line. On a year-over-year basis, eight companies posted higher earnings, while five reported declines.
Revenue performance was also mixed, with eight companies topping analyst estimates and five falling short. However, nine companies reported year-over-year revenue growth, while four posted declines.
Overall, the results point to stronger year-over-year revenue trends, although earnings and sales performance varied across companies.
Here’s a look at how the companies performed:
Amazon
: Q3 GAAP EPS of $1.89 misses by $0.07; Revenue of $201.9B (+12.0% Y/Y) misses by $360M.
Ford
: Q3 adjusted EPS of $0.49 beats by $0.09; Revenue excl/ Ford credit of $46.08B (-2.4% Y/Y) beats by $270M.
Starbucks
: Q4 adj. EPS of $0.80 beats by $0.09; Revenue of $9.14B (-4.8% Y/Y) misses by $90M.
Chipotle Mexican Grill
: Q3 adj. EPS of $0.27 misses by $0.02; Revenue of $3.29B (+9.7% Y/Y) in-line.
Royal Caribbean Cruises
: Q3 adj. EPS of $6.57 beats by $0.19; Revenue of $5.59B (+9.0% Y/Y) misses by $20M.
eBay
: Q3 adj. EPS of $1.51 beats by $0.10; Revenue of $3.2B (+13.5% Y/Y) beats by $90M.
Norwegian Cruise Line
: Q3 adj. EPS of $1.12 beats by $0.18; Revenue of $2.9B (flat Y/Y) beats by $20M.
MGM Resorts
: Q3 adj. EPS of -$0.11 misses by $0.19; Revenue of $4.21B (-0.9% Y/Y) in-line.
D.R. Horton
: Q3 GAAP EPS of $2.67 misses by $0.33; Revenue of $9.37B (-3.2% Y/Y) beats by $260M.
Carvana
: Q3 GAAP EPS of $0.39 misses by $0.05; Revenue of $8.04B (+42.3% Y/Y) beats by $340M.
O'Reilly Automotive
: Q3 GAAP EPS of $0.97 beats by $0.04; Revenue of $5.12B (+8.7% Y/Y) beats by $100M.
Hilton Worldwide
: Q3 adj. EPS of $2.45 beats by $0.08; Revenue of $3.33B (+6.7% Y/Y) misses by $40M.
Garmin
: Q3 GAAP EPS of $2.80 beats by $0.46; Revenue of $1.99B (+12.4% Y/Y) beats by $10M.
Next week, 11 consumer discretionary firms are scheduled to report quarterly results. Among notable ones are McDonald's
, Airbnb
, Booking Holdings
and Doordash
. Analysts expect McDonald's to earn $3.38 on revenue of $7.29B.
Analysts expect Airbnb
to report earnings of $2.85 per share on revenue of $4.75B. Booking Holdings
is projected to earn $4.50 per share on revenue of $9.54B, while DoorDash
is expected to post EPS of $1.58 on revenue of $4.84B.

title: Consumer discretionary earnings mixed as revenue growth outpaces profit gains
